mapper.select: SELECT VARIABLE, TYPE, DESCRIPTION, USERID, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS FROM HDOC_VARIABLES ORDER BY VARIABLE

SELECT VARIABLE AS variable, TYPE AS type, DESCRIPTION AS description, REGISTER_USER AS createdByUser, REGISTER_DATETIME AS date FROM HDOC_VARIABLES WHERE 1=1
AND VARIABLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{variable}, '%')
AND TYPE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{type}, '%')
AND DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', #{description}, '%')
ORDER BY VARIABLE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_VARIABLES ( VARIABLE, TYPE, DESCRIPTION,USERID, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_PROCESS ) VALUES ( #{variable}, #{type}, #{description}, #{userid}, #{registerUser}, #{registerDatetime}, 'UD10Add', #{registerUser}, #{registerDatetime}, 'UD10Add' )
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_VARIABLES SET TYPE = #{type}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, UPDATE_USER = #{updateUser}, UPDATE_DATETIME = #{updateDatetime}, UPDATE_PROCESS = 'UD10Update' WHERE VARIABLE = #{variable}
